title: Figure 24: Example of a generic chiral metamaterial - twisted optical fiber double helix
description: Rendering of an optical fiber whose rectangular core is twisted into a double helix along its length, shown against a pale green background, with red arrows (left-to-right) and blue arrows (right-to-left) indicating propagation directions. Caption: "Figure 24. Example of a Generic Chiral Metamaterial: An Optical Fiber with a Rectangular Cross Section Core Twisted During the Drawing Process Forms a Double Helix." Coupled-mode equations follow below.
